title: The Chalk That Rolled under the Bench
youtube_title: The Chalk That Rolled under the Bench | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a box of chalk that rolled under the bench is awkward for one person. Brisa notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
